title: It does it’s job
text: It does it’s job. The top post came smashed and broken because it’s plastic and the box had a hole. The bed is definitely a two person job. We have a temperpedic so it is a taller mattress than some but the headboard only comes up to the top of the mattress so not a headboard for us at all.

product_metadata.title: Queen Bed Frame with Headboard 14 Inch Platform Bed Frame No Box Spring Needed Metal Queen Size Bed Frame with Storage Heavy Duty Steel Slat and Anti-Slip Support, Easy Quick Lock Assembly - Queen
